source.text: The energy the reactor deposits over the 60 ms window by the independent integration of the point-kinetics equations (2064226.1 J), for the modelled slice (peaking 1, 100 pins of 0.5 m).
source.check: Independent integration: oracles/point-kinetics-reference.py (RK4, not the generator's Dormand-Prince) in the feed-solver distro; the reference file records its inputs; FEED's generator agrees to 1e-5 (tests/pointKinetics.test.ts, reference cases).

coverage.domain: synthetic pin, generated pulse from point kinetics (a 3 dollar step, six delayed groups, constant feedback), constant heat capacity, 60 ms window
